text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq's National Assembly urges Arab parliamentarians to reject U.S.-led aerial surveillance force in northern Iraq.
- Iran frees 722 Iraqi prisoners of war.
- Iraq and Turkey sign agreement to increase trade cooperation.
- Turkey decides to operate its border crossing with Iraq at Kabu, 24 hours a day; crossing is used for Turkish-Iraqi trade.
(The above stories were carried by THAWRA and JUMHOURIYA)
- Studies have been completed on reopening Iraqi Museum, closed since 1991 Gulf War.
- Editorial urging Iran to free all Iraqi prisoners of war jailed in Iran since 1980-1988 war.
